title: Notes
info: A note shows a number. That number is how many taka it is worth.

questions.q: The number printed large on a note tells you
options: how many taka it is worth
the year you must spend it

questions.q: Which note is worth the most?

options: add together to make a price
never be used in the same shop
replace poisha by erasing the 100 rule
